g.text: Production topology: the browser talks only to Vercel, the API, and Supabase Auth.
start: alembic upgrade head, then uvicorn
Render stops a free service after 15 minutes without
every 5 minutes to keep it awake. After any restart,
unfinished runs are marked failed and checkpointed
population and social runs can be resumed.
Google OAuth with PKCE, email and password, anonymous
External APIs, called only by the API
fallback, free tier; only when LLM_FALLBACK_ENABLED
DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, and provider keys exist only as Render environment variables. Vercel holds NEXT_PUBLIC_* values: the API URL, the auth mode, the
Supabase URL, and the publishable key. The browser never calls Qloo, Nebius, OpenRouter, Postgres, or Storage.
